goal: Land the owner-attested solicitation postal address on businesses (migration 098) with a per-location attestation surface on settings/profile, and withhold the send handoff for any location whose address is unattested or whose owner email has bounced.
non_goals: The ask footer itself — #628 already owns it (assembleAskBody takes postalAddress and fails closed on null/blank)
Dispatch-time byte-match re-assertion of the address against the approved bytes (spec 622 par.7.6 point 3) — #630
Anything in spec 622 par.1/2/5/7.1/7.3/9 — the MessagingAdapter seam, sending domain, env vars and webhook lane are #657
Blocking watch-mode batch construction — the batch still builds; only the send handoff is withheld
Adding a WITHHOLD_REASONS member — the enum is closed, precedence-ordered and versioned by RESTRAINT_POLICY_VERSION, and every member is a per-candidate reason while this is a per-location fact
Any new env var, feature flag or analytics event — the durable attestation record is the columns themselves
Structured international address validation (spec 622 par.7.5 calls it a trap; US-first)
Surfacing the withheld-handoff reason in owner UI on the Requests surface — #629 owns that copy
user_visible_behavior: An owner sees a solicitation postal address field on settings/profile for their active location, prefilled from google_place_address as an editable suggestion
The owner cannot save the address without ticking an explicit attestation checkbox stating it is a valid physical postal address or USPS-registered PO box for this business
Editing a saved address requires re-attesting; the saved attestation always covers the bytes currently stored
An address that is blank, single-line, or has no postal code is rejected with a reason before it is stored
A location with no attested postal address, or with owner_email_bounced TRUE, produces its watch-mode batch and Spoilage report as before but does not hand off to ask generation
invariants: Tenant isolation: every read and write is scoped by account_id and the caller's active location_id (invariant #8)

A stored postal address always carries its attestation — address, attested_at, attesting user and attestation_version are all-or-nothing, enforced by a DB CHECK, so no code path can read an unattested address as attested

attested_by_user_id is a plain UUID point-in-time capture with NO FK to users — migration 093 established this after 086's ON DELETE CASCADE meant deleting a staff member deleted their uploads; on businesses that cascade would be catastrophic (invariant #9a capture pattern)
Watch-mode is not regressed: buildSolicitationBatch is one builder shared by both modes, so the precondition attaches to the send-only seam and never to closedGateReason
Domain modules receive their DB client as an explicit parameter; only composition roots import the singleton (invariant #15)
Server-authoritative: no NEXT_PUBLIC_* companion, browser learns state via the API response (invariant #13)
Vercel is UI only — no LLM, external API or long-running work added to any Next.js route (invariant #1)
edge_cases: google_place_address is NULL or is a service-area value like 'Austin, TX, USA' — prefill still offered, but the lint rejects it on save, and it is never silently stored as an attestation
The offboarding purge NULLs google_place_address today; the four new columns must go with it in the same stage
The attesting user is later deleted — the attestation stands, because attested_by_user_id has no FK
An owner edits the address to new bytes without re-ticking the box — the write is refused rather than leaving a stale attestation over new bytes
owner_email_bounced flips TRUE between batch build and the next build — the next build withholds the handoff; nothing retroactively unwinds
A location has sendCount > 0 and SOLICITATION_SEND_ENABLED on but no attested address — one location-level reason is reported, never 25 per-candidate withholds
SOLICITATION_SEND_ENABLED is off (prod today) — the send handoff never fires, so the new precondition is unreachable and the whole change is inert

ask-generation's to_jsonb(b) ->> 'solicitation_postal_address' shim exists solely because the column did not exist; it must be deleted, not left as a fallback (no backwards-compat shims without a named external consumer)

rollback_plan: Revert the PR. Migration 098 is purely additive — four nullable columns on businesses plus one CHECK that constrains only those four columns against each other — so it is inert with the code reverted and needs no down migration; dropping the columns would be a separate deliberate migration. SOLICITATION_SEND_ENABLED is off in every environment, so the send-handoff suppression is unreachable in prod either way. Order: apply 098 to staging Supabase first, ride staging, then prod Supabase in lockstep at promotion.
observability: A structured log line from the batch builder when the send handoff is withheld, carrying the business id and the location-level reason and no contact PII — the signal that a location is silently not sending
The attestation columns themselves are the durable record: querying businesses for solicitation_postal_address_attested_at answers 'which locations may send' directly, with no derived state to drift
A 4xx rate on PUT /api/settings/postal-address indicates the lint is rejecting real owner addresses — the signal that the US-first lint is too strict for the live customer mix
